note: Hocking County publishes no county zoning district layer; its GIS shapefile index (Addresses, Parcels, Townships, Municipalities, etc.) has no zoning. Rural zoning is by township or county zoning commission, with no queryable service. The cities of Logan and Nelsonville publish zoning only as PDF maps (Logan 7/2025 PDF; Nelsonville PDF), with no ArcGIS service or GIS viewer.
